description: This file defines the class TpmRemoteProvisioningContext, which implements a TPM-backed provisioning context for Android's keymaster system. It includes method declarations for cryptographic operations, device info creation, and system configuration related to TPM provisioning.

classes.name: TpmRemoteProvisioningContext
classes.description: A class implementing a TPM-backed remote provisioning context, providing cryptographic and system info functions.

methods.name: TpmRemoteProvisioningContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the context with a TpmResourceManager reference.

methods.name: DeriveBytesFromHbk
methods.description: Derives bytes from the hardware binding key with a specified context.

methods.name: CreateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates device information in the form of a keymaster::cppbor::Map.

methods.name: BuildProtectedDataPayload
methods.description: Builds a protected data payload with test mode, MAC key, and additional data.

methods.name: GenerateHmacSha256
methods.description: Generates an HMAC-SHA256 from input data.

methods.name: GetHwInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information into the provided response object.

methods.name: BuildCsr
methods.description: Builds a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) with a challenge and keys to sign.

methods.name: GenerateBcc
methods.description: Generates a Boot Configuration Certificate (BCC) for a given test mode.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the system's OS version and patch level.

methods.name: SetVerifiedBootInfo
methods.description: Sets information about verified boot state, bootloader state, and VBMeta digest.
